## Run

    mise trust
    mise install
    mise run up

The console opens on http://localhost:10120; the API is behind it at `/api`. Host ports 10100-10199, bound to `127.0.0.1`.
Defaults are local-only placeholders; overrides go in `.deploy/local/.env` (optional, keys as in `.deploy/local/.example.env`).
Without mise: `docker compose -f .deploy/local/docker-compose.yml --profile app up -d --build`.
Stop with `mise run down` (volumes kept). `.deploy/local/README.md` lists every port and service.

## Edit a component on the host

Stop its container, then run it on the host on the same port (`mise run infra` starts the infrastructure alone):

    docker compose -f .deploy/local/docker-compose.yml stop acme-backend-web
    mise run dev:web

Editing acme-backend-srv runs the console on the host too (nginx in the container reaches only the acme-backend-srv container); run each task in its own terminal:

    docker compose -f .deploy/local/docker-compose.yml stop acme-backend-srv acme-backend-web
    mise run dev:srv
    mise run dev:web

Once per clone: `npm --prefix acme-backend-web ci`.
